findings.reason: The workflow title is left in English here while the page title was translated as 'Estender Vídeo', creating an inconsistency across the entry.

findings.suggestion: a pré-visualização mais escura
findings.reason: Glossary requires Preview → Pré-visualização for UI consistency.

findings.suggestion: a pré-visualização de diferença
findings.reason: Glossary requires Preview → Pré-visualização; also matches the other occurrences on the page.

findings.suggestion: Placeholder de VFX (temp)
findings.reason: 'VFX temping' means using temporary/placeholder footage, not timing; 'Temporização' (timing) misstates the use case.

findings.suggestion: gere quadros extras
findings.reason: 'frames' is used here while the rest of the entry consistently uses 'quadros' for frames; inconsistent terminology within the page (also 'um frame com correspondência' in the next item).

findings.suggestion: planos de apresentação (establishing shots)
findings.reason: Mixed English/Portuguese construction that a native speaker would not write.

findings.span: É uma solução prática e rápida
findings.suggestion: É uma solução prática, com um clique,
findings.reason: The English says 'a practical, one-click solution'; the translation replaces 'one-click' with 'fast' (rápida), dropping the key claim that is used consistently in the title/description/metaDescription.

findings.suggestion: difíceis de reconstruir por inpainting
findings.reason: 'inpaintar' is an invented verb not used in Portuguese; elsewhere the text keeps 'inpainting' as a noun, so this is inconsistent and reads unnaturally.

findings.suggestion: marca d'água de pré-visualização
findings.reason: Glossary requires 'preview' to be rendered as 'pré-visualização'; the English word is left untranslated.

findings.suggestion: em duas passagens
findings.reason: English 'two passes' refers to two generation passes; 'passos' (steps) also collides with the 'PASSO 1/2' labels used later for STEP, blurring the distinction.

findings.suggestion: STEP 1 – PREVIS STILL FRAME (PASSO 1 – QUADRO STILL DE PRÉ-VISUALIZAÇÃO)
findings.reason: This is an in-workflow group title that appears in English in the UI; it is translated here while the sibling label 'INPUT SCENE DESCRIPTION' is left in English, which is inconsistent and makes the group hard to locate. 'FRAME' is also dropped.

findings.suggestion: gera uma pré-visualização rápida image-to-video
findings.reason: 'Preview' is rendered as 'prévia' here and in the FAQ but as 'Pré-visualização' in the metaDescription; the glossary requires 'Pré-visualização', so the page is internally inconsistent.

findings.span: um setup médio de quadra de tênis
findings.suggestion: um enquadramento médio-aberto em quadra de tênis
findings.reason: 'medium-wide' is a shot size; the translation drops 'wide' and reads as a 'medium setup' rather than a medium-wide framing.

findings.suggestion: o fluxo de trabalho usa JsonExtractString
findings.reason: 'workflow' must be rendered as 'fluxo de trabalho'; here it is shortened to 'o fluxo', inconsistent with the rest of the entry.

findings.span: use o fluxo de trabalho para testar várias opções de cabelo
findings.suggestion: use o fluxo de trabalho Trocador de Penteado para experimentar várias opções de cabelo
findings.reason: The name of the workflow ('hairstyle changer workflow') is omitted from the translation.

findings.suggestion: usando as entradas preparadas anteriormente
findings.reason: English says 'inputs' (Entradas), not 'parameters'; the same sentence later distinguishes text parameters.

findings.suggestion: por meio do processador personalizado
findings.reason: 'via o' is ungrammatical/awkward in Portuguese; 'via' is not followed by an article.

findings.suggestion: acessórios de cabelo volumosos
findings.reason: Omits 'hair' from 'heavy hair accessories', making the advice less specific.
